notes.notes: New version with lot of little bugs fixed.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Hi all,

After leaving Early Acess weeks ago, now I am uploading a new patch full of minor bugs solved.

Hope you like it.

Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: Leaving Early Access soon
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Next year is coming and the game is going to be close to leaving Early Access.
This time I want to announce 0.9.5 with a lot of changes.

[list]
[*] Splash Video added when starts.
[*] UI has received some changes to make it better.
[*] More gamepads compatibility added.
[*] Camera TV bug fixed.
[*] Performance issue solved when playing several games in a row.
[*] Replays works smoother.
[*] New Pass animations added.
[/list]

See you soon with the final release and more news.

Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: New change-input-player behavior
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I am happy to announce a new and relevant change in a specific game mecanim.
Some customers just complain about "change-player" behavior, it was totally automatic and not very reliable... until now.

You will feel the switching of players will be very fast now, but now you will need to use LB button in Gamepads or Shift-Right on Keyboard to change player manually in certains cases. This way of work is quite similar to FIFA or PES.

I hope to get more feedback about it on Discord to know your opinion. 

See you next week!
Ruben

notes.title: More UI elements and Amazing ambience sounds
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We are every day nearest to the final version of the game. I expect one month to leave Early Access to release build.

I want to emphasize about now I added a free demo, so now, if you are thinking about purchasing the game you can play a bit.

Also, I am very happy to announce I have added a lot of new ambience sounds, I did spend some money to get really professional stuff.

Also, now players have a little profile picture that you will see in team squads. I think it improves so much the UI of the game.

Guys, hope you are happier with gameplay, lot of bugs were solved. Next week I will work in "input-player-change" because I feel it is not 100% reliable.

Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: Stadium details and fastest gameplay
notes.notes:
Good morning from Spain,

Let me show you a new version of the game (0.8.0). The main subject is about new Stadium graphics adding a lot of details and new lightmaps in order to get an amazing look.

Also, you will enjoy of fastest gameplay and improved AI, focused in better dribblings.

One more thing.... this week, probably today, I will add a Demo of the game available on Steam. In order to have fewer returns of game, I prefer to show the game free before to purchase the full version.

Thank you for time.

Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: Tactics modifications
notes.notes:
Hi all,

In 0.7.0 version I have added some important modification in our 3 tactics ( 5-3-2, 4-3-3 and 3-4-3 ).

Now players just tactically move more aggressively, in defence and in attack. Probably the game will feel more difficult to play, so I will wait to get feedback to make any new adjustment.

I hope you like it!

Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: PATCH 0.6.0 adding Cup mode
notes.notes:
[h2]CUP MODE[/h2]

Finally, I finished the Cup mode adding EuroCup and AmericaCup with all teams on 2021 editions.
So now, you can play Friendly Games, Trainings, Leagues and Cups.

[h2]NEW UI[/h2]

Also, you will find a new different look in Buttons and other elements in UI, now it looks more like cartoon style.


Hope you like it and enjoy the cups, see you next week in another exciting update.

Cheers,
Rubén

notes.title: macOS compatible NOW!
notes.notes:
Before of releasing at the end of this week the CUP mode in game, I have compiled the game on macOS and works perfectly.

So if you are a macOS user or know anyone just play it!

See you and the end of week... again....

Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: QA and Testing
notes.notes:
This week I introduce you 0.5.0 version of the game.

Thanks so much to [b]Piculín Cler[/b] for testing deeply and help to improve gameplay. We finally removed all fatal crashes of the game and also the major part of bugs.

I encourage people who played early versions of the game to play it again, it will not disappoint you :)

See you next week with Cup Competitions ready!

Cheers,
Rubén

notes.title: More content now!
notes.notes:
Guys,

After a little delay, I can present you new version 0.4.0, full of new things.

CO-OP mode now allows you to play with another friend in the same team. Just select 2 controllers in a side to activate it.

and

TRAINING MODE, now you can play without an opponent team, so you will train passes, shoots, control and everything in a match.


On the other hand, I found a lot of new bugs which are going to be fixed, thank for your feedback with bugs.


Keep on going! Soon we will be on the half of Early Access.

Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: Patch 0.3.5 with keyboard support
notes.notes:
A new weekend and a new update of SUPER ARCADE SOCCER 2021 arrives! ːsteamhappyː

This time 0.3.5 with a lot of bugs solved and any improvement, but the most important add is...

[h2]KEYBOARD SUPPORT[/h2]

From now, if you want to play with keyboard you can use ArrowKeys and Z,X,C,A. I hope to add redefine keys in future.

See you next week in the next big update, probably 0.4.0.

Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0 just released!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 0.3.0 is available [b]NOW[/b][/h1]

First of all, I hope you accept my apologies because the first release of game was full of bugs, much more than I expected.
It is difficult to make excuses but certainly being a solo developer is really hard and complicated, especially to be alert of all problems related to the game. 
Anyway, NO EXCUSES, I know. Around 30% buyers just returned the game and that situation was really sad for me.

I am EVERY DAY working in game-fixing all possible bugs and improving gameplay, during this week I have done a lot of progress and you can see them NOW just updating the game from your Steam library.

I beg you to have patience because Super Arcade Soccer 2021 is going to be...

[h3]YOUR FAVORITE SOCCER GAME OF LAST YEARS[/h3]

Remember, each week you will see important improvements in the game and I will love to hear from you any opinion.

Sincerely,
Ruben
